The Biggle browser for your computer. Pick the file for your system from **Assets** below.

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and newer) | `Bigglenet_…_aarch64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `Bigglenet_…_x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `Bigglenet_…_x64-setup.exe` |
| Linux | `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm` |

On a phone, open **https://bigglenet.ethembeldagli.dev** and add it to your home screen.

### Opening it the first time

The apps aren't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet, so your computer will warn you once.

- **Mac:** open Bigglenet, close the warning, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. If macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Bigglenet.app` in Terminal.
- **Windows:** click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

You need an invite code to make an account. Ask someone who's already on the Bigglenet.
